caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) across different ratios of shared sub-dimensions to total sub-dimensions for two models: Transformer and MoHD. The x-axis, labeled "Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims," is a categorical scale with four evenly spaced tick marks at 0/4, 1/4, 2/4, and 3/4, representing the proportion of shared sub-dimensions. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL," is a continuous scale ranging from 10.0 to 12.5, with horizontal gridlines at intervals of 0.5. The Transformer model is represented by a dashed red line, which remains constant at a value of 11.5 across all four x-axis points. The MoHD model is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, which shows a decreasing trend from a value of approximately 11.0 at 0/4 to 10.2 at 3/4, followed by an increase to approximately 10.7 at 4/4. The area between the two lines is shaded in light blue, visually emphasizing the difference in performance between the two models across the tested settings.
